name: surveil-prenuncio-1
summary: Multi-family GBDT ensemble (LGBM+XGB+Hurdle) with RADD SAR, GFW, AEF dynamics & JEV signals

code.provenance: Maintainer archive of the submitted source. Original training commit was not supplied.

data_sources.name: INPE PRODES 10 m raster (2025 release) + 2026 priority scenes
data_sources.dates: 2008-2025 wall-to-wall, 2026 priority scenes; forecast T uses <= T-1

data_sources.name: INPE DETER-B alerts & Programa Queimadas AQUA reference fires
Hansen Global Forest Change v1.13 (lossyear, treecover2000, gain)
UMD GLAD Sentinel-2 disturbance alerts (10 m)
JRC Tropical Moist Forest v1 first-disturbance year (30 m)
Google AlphaEarth Foundations annual satellite embeddings (64-dim)
data_sources.dates: 2018-2025; strictly calendar years <= T-2 (velocity, cosine shift, spatial contrast)

data_sources.name: WUR RADD Sentinel-1 SAR alerts (v20261115) & GFW Integrated Alerts (v20261122)
data_sources.dates: 2020-2026; decoded day = R*255+G since 2014-12-31, strictly <= 31 Jul T-1

data_sources.name: IBAMA SINAFLOR permits (ASV/UAS/PMFS), DOF logging auths, Flora infractions & Embargoes (JEV-scored non-PII text)
data_sources.dates: 2007-2026; strictly issued/event date <= 31 Jul T-1; zero PII read or persisted

data_sources.name: CHIRPS v3.0 monthly rainfall (0.05 deg)
data_sources.dates: 2005-2026; strictly hydrological 12m Aug T-2..Jul T-1 and dry May-Jul T-1

data_sources.name: ANM SIGMINE Legal Amazon mining processes

compute.hardware: 3x Apple M5 Max (18 CPU cores, 40-core Metal GPU, 128 GB unified RAM each); final 14M-cell maps produced on 1x M5 Max (c3ru-5s)

tools.name: Self-hosted LLM evolutionary swarm (GLM-5.2/5.3, Kimi-K3, DeepSeek-V4.1) + TypeSafe JEV-1.13.0 + Cursor Gemini orchestrator
tools.how: Orchestrated 144 overnight experiments, engineered 15 candidate feature packs, ran 30 cross-family red-team leakage audits, and generated clean standalone reproduction code; final leakage audit, jump tests, and official 14M-cell scoring were verified directly.
